sv.title: Länder som vill ha solidaritet måste också visa den
sv.summary: Europa vilar på solidaritet mellan folken. Det avgör hur EU-budgeten ser ut. Och det avgör hur Ukrainakriget utvecklas. När budgetdramat nu går mot sitt avgörande har principerna vävts ihop. Det är bra.

en.title: Countries that want solidarity must also show it
en.summary: Europe rests on solidarity between peoples. That determines what the EU budget looks like. And it determines how the war in Ukraine develops. As the budget drama now moves toward its decisive point, the principles have been woven together. That is good.
